message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  # Trigger the workflow on push or pull request,
  # but only for the master branch
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  release:
    types: # This configuration does not affect the page_build event above
      - created

jobs:
  build:

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform: [
          ubuntu-latest,
          macos-latest,
          windows-latest
        ]
        version:
          - 1.80.0
          - stable
          - nightly

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v1
      - name: Install toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.version }}
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --verbose
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --verbose
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all --all-features --verbose",
  "rationale": "P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) applies: this is a Rust workspace with a pinned Cargo.lock, CI repeats on master, and the workflow has no existing cache step. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed on the Cargo.lock hash, reuses downloaded dependencies across the matrix and repeat runs while keeping every build/test step (cargo build, cargo test, cargo test --all --all-features) intact. The measured experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 reported about 20.4% elapsed savings from adding a dependency cache; the pattern preconditions (repeatable dependency fetching, lockfile-keyed inputs) are met, and no contraindication (mutable/untrusted cached content or an equivalent existing cache) applies.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

name: CI

  # Trigger the workflow on push or pull request,

  push:
    branches:

      - name: Install toolchain

        with:

          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --verbose
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --verbose
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all --all-features --verbose
